description: This Java class implements a Spring Batch tasklet responsible for purging processed command events older than a certain age. It interacts with a repository and configuration service to determine which events to delete.

classes.name: PurgeProcessedCommandsTasklet
classes.description: A Spring Batch tasklet that deletes processed command events older than a configured number of days.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the purge operation by calculating the cutoff date and invoking the repository to delete old events.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the tasklet, performing the deletion of old processed command events based on configured criteria.
